name: The Ravaged Caravan
summary: In Mulgore, The Ravaged Caravan leaves the Bloodhoof Outrunners with proof of an illegal foothold in tauren territory. The Venture Company is stripping the land's mineral wealth, and the Outrunners prepare to defend their ancestral plains.

sections.title: Evidence of Exploitation
sections.body: East of Bloodhoof Village, a ravaged caravan lies beside the road. Inside a sealed supply crate are mined ore and minerals, along with a bound sheaf of Venture Company documents. The papers prove the company has begun mining deep in Mulgore's tranquil valleys without permission.

sections.title: The Outrunners' Vigil
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker and his fellow Outrunners watch Mulgore's borders with care. They fear outside factions will exploit their peaceful homeland. When Morin receives the recovered documents, they confirm his worst fears. Smoke rising over the eastern foothills signals an escalating commercial invasion. The tauren must push back against the defilers before their hills are gutted entirely.

faq.q: What is inside the sealed supply crate?
faq.answer: The sealed supply crate holds mined ore and raw minerals beside a bound sheaf of Venture Company documents outlining its operations.
Morin Cloudstalker is a tauren Outrunner stationed on the road east of Bloodhoof Village toward the Barrens border. He patrols Mulgore and tracks foreign threats.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company seeks to exploit Mulgore's natural resources and mineral veins, cutting into the hills without regard for the earth or its people.

faq.q: Where did the caravan come from?
faq.answer: The caravan belonged to the Venture Company. It carried mined ore and operational paperwork out from the company's foothill operations before it was destroyed along the trail.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: With the documents in hand, Morin Cloudstalker directs warriors to confront the Venture Company's leadership and dismantle its mining operation in the eastern foothills.

faq.q: Why does this threaten the tauren?
faq.answer: The tauren consider the land sacred and revere the Earth Mother. The Venture Company's reckless strip mining and industrial pollution defile Mulgore's pristine landscape.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may see crude machinery tearing into Mulgore's ancestral plains as an affront to the Earth Mother and an act of war against your newfound peace.
As a member of the Horde, you know its safety depends on Mulgore's loyalty and stability. Foreign merchant cartels despoiling its hills threaten Thunder Bluff itself.
As a druid, you hold the balance of the land sacred. The Venture Company's destructive, smoke-choked strip mining is a desecration that must be cleansed.
As a miner, you can see that the high-grade ores packed in the crate prove rich subterranean veins lie beneath Mulgore's eastern hills, drawing outsiders eager to exploit them.
